profileLabel: Left-leaning economics (low confidence, co-authored); no other dimension scored
summary: Nueva Ecija 3rd District representative with 98 principal-authored bills. Authored a redefinition of legal separation effects, city autonomy over health funds, a rationalization of dangerous drugs and marijuana penalties and travel-tax abolition. Co-authored a solidarity contribution on the affluent, national minimum wage and bills on technology-facilitated violence against women.
caveat: Economic score rests on two co-authored bills. Drug-penalty and legal-separation bills are single issues and not scored. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored a solidarity contribution on affluent Filipinos (-3) and national minimum wage (-2). Two issues, co-authored only, so low confidence.
